title: Lighting Beacon Hill and killing the Lost Sentry at Cairnwatch (Wardmoor) give no in-the-moment sign that they matter; their payoff (Watch standing) only surfaces if you happen to talk to Sergeant Hale at Highward's parade ground afterward — easy to light/kill and never learn it was worth reporting.
